title: 336 Hz / The Signal
lyrics:
Track 1: "336 Hz / The Signal"
Genre: Melodic Tech-House / Minimal Electronic
Vibe: Sophisticated, rhythmic, and resonant. Built around the 336 Hz frequency to ground the track in your family code.

Instrumentation:

The Hook: A recurring, crisp synth pluck tuned exactly to 336 Hz that pulses like a beacon.

The Groove: A tight, dry percussion kit—kicks that hit with architectural precision and high-hats that provide the "drive."

Atmosphere: Subtle, sweeping ambient textures that mimic the sound of a radio scanning across bands, never settling on a station until the drop.

Production Notes: Use your signature "CoreyAI" clean mastering. No clutter. The silence between the beats is just as important as the notes themselves. This track is the "backbone" of the new era.
